claims.quote: Although the use of asbestos has declined, due to the long latency of disease onset (20 to 40 years), asbestosis remains an important public health concern.

claims.text: Symptoms Most common presentation: gradual, progressive dyspnea on exertion, nonproductive cough and fatigue; generally progresses slowly over many years and can continue after exposure stops
claims.quote: The most common clinical presentation is gradual and progressive dyspnea on exertion, nonproductive cough, and fatigue. Generally, asbestosis progresses slowly over many years and can continue to progress after cessation of exposure.
